name: Theater Camp in Lincoln Woods State Park
description_short: An outdoor theater day camp for ages 5-12 in Lincoln Woods State Park, 8:30am-3:30pm. Campers play theater games, rehearse, design props and costume pieces in the Craft & Create program, and each week ends with an outdoor performance. Two separate weeks in summer 2027.
activities: Theme days (water day, costume day, camp olympics)
swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming during camp. The park has a beach with lifeguards, and families can swim there after pickup (lifeguards are on duty until 6pm).

sources.note: Re-checked 2026-11-12: 'Summer 2027 Outdoor Theater Camp Lincoln Woods State Park Ages 5-12'; 'Session 1: June 28 — July 1, 2027 / Session 2: August 16—20, 2027'; 'Pricing $395 — Early Summer Session (4 Days) / $475 — Early Summer Session (5 Days)'; 8:30 drop-off, 3:30 pick-up; students bring lunch; 'Camp is 100% outdoors'; 'Apply for Financial Aid'; no swimming during camp.
